title: Simple Market Bag
description: A lightweight everyday bag with a sturdy base and open mesh body.
expectationText: A useful bag project that mixes solid structure and open mesh so you can practice changing from dense rows into airy repeated rounds.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.instruction: Create an oval or rectangle base using chains and single crochet increases around the ends.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work the first round evenly around the base and place a marker at the start.

steps.title: Strengthen the base edge
steps.instruction: Single crochet one or two rounds with no increases to make the bottom more stable.

steps.title: Start the mesh body
steps.instruction: Alternate chain spaces and anchor stitches to create an open mesh pattern.

steps.title: Add straps
steps.instruction: Chain long handle openings and reinforce them with one more round of stitches.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off after the strap round and weave in the ends securely.
